newsitem.title: UK: UK intervention board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: UK intervention board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total of 34,500 tonnes of current series white sugar recieved export rebates of a maximum 43.069 ECUs per 100 kilograms at Wednesday's EU tender, the UK intervention board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 22,500 tonnes, in Germany 3,000 and in the U.K. 9,000, it added.
This week's award brings the cumulative tonnage awarded for export from the 1996/97 crop to 1.906 million tonnes.
Last week the EU awarded 73,500 tonnes at its weekly tender when the restitution was 43.542 Ecus.
